[d.fresh, d.complete, d.valid, d.prov, d.recon]

      .slice(0, 2)
      .join

[d.fresh, d.complete, d.valid, d.prov, d.recon]

      .slice

[
          ["Precision", pct(score.precision), "winner | fired", score.lift > 1],
          ["Recall", pct(score.recall), "fired | winner", score.recall >= 0.6],
          ["Specificity", pct(score.specificity), "reject | fizzle", score.specificity >= 0.6],
          [
            "Lead time",
            score.median_lead_months !== null ? `${score.median_lead_months}mo` : "—",
            "before consensus",
            (score.median_lead_months ?? 0) > 0,
          ],
        ].map

[
          ["Lift", `${score.lift.toFixed(2)}×`, "precision ÷ base rate", score.lift > 1],
          ["Precision", pct(score.precision), "winner | fired", score.lift > 1],
          ["Recall", pct(score.recall), "fired | winner", score.recall >= 0.6],
          ["Specificity", pct(score.specificity), "reject | loser", score.specificity >= 0.6],
        ].map

r
      .map((x, i) => ({ p: x.probability, y: y[i] }))
      .filter

fired
    .filter((c) => c.outcome === 1 && c.lead_months !== null)
    .map((c) => c.lead_months as number)
    .sort

scored
    .filter((r) => r.fired === 1 && r.label_winner === 1 && r.lead_months !== null)
    .map((r) => r.lead_months as number)
